class.name: SteamPublisherPurchaseLine
class.brief_description: An immutable server-priced Steam Wallet line.
class.description: The trusted store maps one unpriced cart SKU to a positive Steam item ID and localized description. [member total] covers the entire quantity.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a validated priced line, or null for an empty or oversized SKU or description, out-of-range item ID or quantity, or nonpositive total.

method.name: get_sku
method.description: Game catalog SKU, up to 96 characters.

method.name: get_item_id
method.description: Positive unsigned 32-bit Steam item ID configured by the game.

method.name: get_quantity
method.description: Positive count of units, up to 32767.

method.name: get_total
method.description: Total for the whole line in the original quote's Steam currency units.

method.name: get_description
method.description: Trusted localized Steam checkout text, up to 128 characters.

members.member: Game catalog SKU, up to 96 characters.
Positive unsigned 32-bit Steam item ID configured by the game.
Positive count of units, up to 32767.
Total for the whole line in the original quote's Steam currency units.
